author: reek
body: The founding flagship: a machine-checked proof that reversing a list twice returns the original. Proven by structural induction over a self-contained list, resting on a chain of lemmas -- append-nil, append-assoc, reverse-append -- each an induction in its own right, applied at specific arguments inside the next. This exercises the whole Stage 5 stack: nested for-all binders, N-ary constructor congruence (cong / app-cong), and applicable lemmas.
